translation.name: Yesus Aqa Anjam Bole 2014 + Qotei qa Lou

content: Tamo a Jerusalem qure qa areboleboleiyeqnu
Tamo qudei naŋgi na e endegsib merbeb, “Ni au. Iga Tamo Koba Qotei aqa atra talq gilqom.” Naŋgi e degsib merbonabqa e tulaŋ areboleboleibej.
Deqa e naŋgi ti koba na walwelosim gilsim Jerusalem qureq di brantosim marem, “O Jerusalem, bini iga ino siraŋ miligiq di tigelejunum.”
Nami tal gereiyo tamo naŋgi na Jerusalem qure gereiyosib aqa utru siŋgilateb deqa a tulaŋ bole unu.
Bini Israel naŋgo moma utru 12 naŋgo leŋ naŋgi Tamo Koba Qotei aqa dal anjam dauryqajqa are qaloqnsib Jerusalem qureq giloqnsib Qotei aqa ñam biŋiyeqnub.
Jerusalem dia mandor naŋgo awo jaram unub. Naŋgi awo jaramq di awooqnsib tamo uŋgasari naŋgo une qa naŋgi peginjreqnub. Mandor naŋgi di Devit aqa leŋ.
Niŋgi endegsib Qotei pailyoqniy, “Tamo uŋgasari Jerusalem qalaqalaiyeqnub qaji naŋgi bole soqnebe. Jerusalem a qoto saiqoji lawo soqneme.
Jerusalem a dadaŋ ti unu. Aqa tal kokba miligiq dia tamo uŋgasari naŋgi qoto saiqoji lawo soqnebe.” Niŋgi degsib Qotei pailyoqniy.
Od, e ijo was naŋgi qa ti ijo kadoi naŋgi qa ti are qaloqnsim endegsi Jerusalem minjeqnum, “Ni qoto saiqoji lawo soqne.”
E gago Tamo Koba Qotei aqa atra tal qa are qaloqnsim endegsi Jerusalem minjeqnum, “Ni bole soqnime.”
